search: full red MSER plus bright-only blue MSER and at most two learned blue proposals
design: Integrate all four previously trained/exported paired localizers with the frozen lower-cost search and original classifier. Reproduce parent decisions. Screen complete TRAIN scenes then all three repeated related development panels, regardless of outcome. No retraining, parameter/threshold tuning, or new labels.
candidate_gate: Background candidate is eligible only for isolated Pi comparison if all TRAIN/development per-color TP are no lower, FP no higher and every previously matched target identity retained relative to the current lower-cost parent. Report matched controls and both seeds; any candidate selection remains development-driven, not independent qualification.
pi_comparison: Only eligible candidates: single active pipeline, sequential counterbalanced paired replay with unchanged classifier/search/selection. Camera, display and serial excluded. No active model replacement.
